change_log.summary: 从当前正式workbench机械迁移稳定task_id、路线动作、步骤与几何；玩家备注/地图悬浮标签/时间模型分别归属Task Presentation、UI、Timing。

Semantic-parity migration for Zuldrak Task 12710 window: preserve the old player-visible compound fixed-transport sentence as one atomic action (Voltarus -> upper chamber -> Pain Box -> upper chamber), then place the task actions at an explicit post-cycle upper-chamber visit. No intermediate geometry is invented.

Semantic-parity cleanup: removed reviewed legacy special transport styles from Zuldrak Bonegut/Gymer/arena/prophet/Mamthoth/Akari target points. Old player text contains task/vehicle phases or outgoing hearth instructions, not special arrival operations; explicit actions remain and unproven arrivals stay unresolved.

Rebuilt the Voltarus/Reliquary of Pain chain from old player text, Task Cards, Questie coordinates, and WotLK portal mechanics. Repeated Pain Box->Voltarus entries use the transfer platform while disguised; Voltarus exits return to Pain Box. Task 12710 uses the Musty Coffin upper-chamber anchor (27.23,42.30), then returns to Pain Box before Sabotage. Betrayal explicitly re-enters Voltarus, talks to Drakuru for the top transport, fights at the Last Wish anchor (28.63,44.54), then uses the Last Wish to return to Pain Box. Step-06 now ends only after Sabotage at Pain Box; step-07 begins with Stefan handoff.
